animations.notes: Wix uses Thunderbolt's internal animation system. Entrance, scroll, hover, and loop animations available. Uses react-transition-group internally.

quirks.description: Wix sites maintain persistent connections (analytics, fedops, warmup data) preventing Playwright networkidle from resolving. 2 of 3 tested sites timed out.
quirks.workaround: Use waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' plus waitForTimeout(5000) for Wix sites.

quirks.description: Sections are buried 12 DOM levels deep: body > #SITE_CONTAINER > #main_MF > #site-root > #masterPage > #PAGES_CONTAINER > #SITE_PAGES > transition group > page > container > mesh > section.wixui-section.
All [data-mesh-id$=inlineContent] containers have pointer-events: none with children having pointer-events: auto. This is Wix's mesh layout system.
quirks.workaround: Ignore pointer-events in style extraction; it's a layout mechanism, not visual styling.

quirks.description: Wix generates short hash-based class names (MazNVa, xU8fqS) that change across deployments. Only wixui-* classes and comp-* IDs are stable.
quirks.workaround: Use wixui-* classes and comp-* IDs for identification. Ignore hash-based classes for labeling.

quirks.description: Background images are in a parallel #BACKGROUND_GROUP tree and per-section [id^='bgLayers_'] elements, not on sections themselves.
quirks.workaround: Extract backgrounds from [id^='bgLayers_comp-'] elements, matching to sections by comp ID suffix.

quirks.description: Wix uses custom elements: <wix-dropdown-menu> for navigation, <wow-image> for images. These wrap standard HTML inside.

quirks.description: Wix defines theme as CSS custom properties (--color_0, --font_0) with RGB triplet values (255,255,255) not standard CSS colors.
quirks.workaround: Extract CSS variables and convert RGB triplets to proper CSS color values.
